description: Read a trace from the live engine through the redactor, for an investigation comparing the frozen snapshot with what is there now. Answers null once the trace has left the engine's ring.

include_spans.description: Also return the flat span list, for a trace whose shape matters more than its tree.

redactions.description: Values rewritten before the response left this worker.

trace.description: Null when the trace has already left the engine's ring: the frozen evidence is then all there is.
